\subsection{End-to-End Results}
\label{sec:e2e}

Table~\ref{tab:e2e} reports end-to-end execution time for MHOT and the
revm~14.0 baseline on the five workloads of \S\ref{sec:setup}. MHOT is faster
on every workload, from $2.22\times$ on \texttt{nft-mint} to $3.84\times$ on
\texttt{erc20-heavy}, with a geometric mean speedup of $2.82\times$. We
summarize with the geometric mean of per-workload speedups; an arithmetic mean
over execution times would be dominated by the longest-running workload.

The spread across workloads tracks how much of each workload's time MHOT is
able to remove. \texttt{erc20-heavy} gains the most because its transactions
re-enter a small set of short transfer bodies, amortizing MHOT's per-contract
setup cost over many invocations of the same code. \texttt{uniswap-v3}
($2.97\times$) and \texttt{defi-mixed} ($3.06\times$) are arithmetic-intensive
and likewise spend most of their time inside contract bodies rather than in
state access.

The two lowest speedups come from workloads whose cost lies outside contract
execution. \texttt{nft-mint} ($2.22\times$) is dominated by cold storage
writes, which MHOT leaves unchanged. \texttt{proxy-chain} ($2.30\times$) pays
repeated cross-contract dispatch through delegate calls, so a larger share of
its time falls outside the regions MHOT optimizes. Even on these two workloads
MHOT more than doubles throughput, and no workload regresses; the next
subsection attributes the gains to individual mechanisms.
```

带注释的同一份存成了 `sec4_2_e2e.tex`（就这一个文件，没建目录）。

**发给导师前要确认的三处：**

1. `\S\ref{sec:setup}` —— 我不知道你 §4.1 的实际 label，按你 tex 里的改，否则渲染成 `??`。
2. **"MHOT's per-contract setup cost"** 和第三段两处归因（nft-mint 归到 cold storage writes、proxy-chain 归到 delegate call dispatch）**是我从 workload 语义推的，不是从你 §3 推的** —— 你没贴 §3，我手上没有 MHOT 的机制。这几句读起来像在讲你的系统，实际需要你对着 §3 核一遍，尤其是"MHOT leaves unchanged"这种对自己系统下限制性断言的话。
3. 表内数字我只做了自洽性检查，没法验证它们和实验的对应关系。

另外我把 nft-mint 单独切成了一句，方便周三之后改。**改那一句时连带要动的**：第一段的 `$2.22\times$ on \texttt{nft-mint}` 和 geomean `$2.82\times$`；如果新 speedup 超过 2.30，nft-mint 就不再是最低值，第三段的顺序和归因得重写。
